items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations or Human Resources Management or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience providing leadership including training, evaluation, mentoring, coaching, motivating and performance management.
Experience in a supervisory or managerial role

Progressive/increased responsibility and experience managing/working in a large complex organization; as well as experience in planning, developing, and executing new processes and procedures, analyzing workﬂow and designing eﬃcient business processes
Experience in managing personnel transactions unit in a shared services or similar high volume environment.
Experience with measurement, metrics, and/or KPIs to drive continuous improvement within operation.
Experience to design and deliver multi-audience training and presentations.
Experience with HR, payroll and time and attendance systems and records, spreadsheet, word processing, email, and presentation software applications.

Experience to understand, interpret and apply Federal State and University employment laws, regulations, and policies governing business activities, conﬁdentiality of records and information and use of technology.

Skills to communicate clearly and effectively, and ability to adjust style based on varying audiences; as well as interpersonal skills to interact effectively with stakeholders and team members with a diverse range of background and experience.

The University of California Davis Shared Services Organization focuses on providing high quality and cost effective services to the University community. Continuous improvement of client, partner and employee experience coupled with the need to change in response to rapidly evolving business needs make the SSO a very dynamic and fast-paced service oriented environment. Reporting to the Associate Director, Davis Campus HR & Payroll, the HR Records & Compliance Supervisor will lead a team of Human Resource professionals, with the goal of delivering an exceptional and consistent customer service experience. This role provides the opportunity for a rewarding professional experience with the ability to develop and maintain strong partnerships across the university, and drive results for the team, the department, and the SSO client base. The incumbent will focus on continuous improvement and will draw insights from analytics to ensure accuracy and compliance as well as make the workﬂow processes more eﬃcient in a high volume and fast-paced service center. The incumbent will inﬂuence decisions and bring a data-driven approach to service delivery by the team in support of the university’s organizational excellence efforts.

Knowledge of human resources and payroll practices, policies, and operational procedures; as well as skill to analyze and evaluate complex information, data, or problems in an objective manner and suggest solutions.
Knowledge of UCD and UC proprietary systems, UCPath, PeopleAdmin, AggieService, TRS, COGNOS.
Knowledge of UC and UC Davis personnel policy, procedures, practices and collective bargaining agreements.
Ability to continue to acquire and enhance working knowledge of employment practices, procedures and law, in a HEERA collective bargaining environment.
